llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads msgFilterRules.dat from /home/user/.thunderbird, which is the right file for Thunderbird message filters.
Getter correctly parses filter blocks using name/action/actionValue lines and identifies forward actions via case-insensitive 'forward' substring check.
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule': receives rules dict directly and accesses expected.get('forward_to') without wrapping, which matches the framework's get_rule behavior.
Expected value {'forward_to': 'anonym-x2024@gmail.com'} correctly reflects the instruction's destination email requirement.
Postconfig closes Thunderbird before evaluation; file-based getter does not need the application running, so this is appropriate.
Case-insensitive email comparison handles real-world email address variations correctly.

Minor gap: getter searches all msgFilterRules.dat files across the entire .thunderbird directory without filtering by account (anonym-x2024@outlook.com). In this single-account OSWorld snapshot this is unlikely to cause false positives.
Minor gap: getter does not verify the 'match all messages' condition on the filter, but verifying the forward action and destination email covers the core requirement of the instruction.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally: filter msgFilterRules.dat path to the one associated with anonym-x2024@outlook.com (e.g., by checking the parent directory name or the Mail/Local Folders path) to ensure account-specific verification.
Optionally: add a check that the filter's condition is 'match all' (matchAll=yes in msgFilterRules.dat) to fully verify the 'all incoming emails' requirement.
